newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon wins air force contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon wins air force contract.

text.p: Raytheon Electronic Systems said Wednesday it has been awarded a $133.6 million contract, for the production of AIM-120B/C Advanced Medium Range Air-to-Air Missiles (AMRAAM).
The company said the award was made by the U.S. Air Force Aeronautical Systems Center Air-to-Air Joint Systems Program Office, Eglin Air Force Base, Florida.
The company said the contract calls for the fabrication, assembly, inspection, and test of a total of 385 AMRAAM missiles, as well as the delivery of associated spares and services.
Raytheon said it has produced, or is under contract for the production of, more than 4,550 such missiles.
